entities.name: GRP58 (PDIA3)
observations: In HeLa cervical adenocarcinoma cells, GRP58 knockdown was reported to stabilize and increase β-catenin; authors conclude GRP58 negatively regulates β-catenin stability.

entities.name: β-catenin (CTNNB1)
observations: Accumulated and stabilized after GRP58 knockdown in HeLa cells; PMID 25081282.

entities.name: PMID:25081282
observations: Liao et al., BMC Cancer. 2014;14:555. DOI:10.1186/1471-2407-14-555. Reports GRP58 negatively regulates β-catenin stability in HeLa cervical adenocarcinoma cells.

entities.name: GRP58 stabilizes β-catenin
observations: Stable GRP58 knockdown in HeLa cells led to stabilized, accumulated β-catenin; the study concludes endogenous GRP58 negatively regulates β-catenin stability.
